status: Local declaration before geology selection, null simulation and field evaluation; not external preregistration
scope: Boundary-normal contrasts and shifted-line negative controls, plus descriptive regional decomposition of the previously identified 23 cells
magnetic_model: Langlais et al. 2019, degree 134, evaluated directly from local coefficients
station_rule: All unique vertices of the supplied closed polyline; drop duplicated final vertex. Base-curve Voronoi arc weights: half previous plus half next segment length.
normal_rule: Spherical tangent from points 100 km before and after each station along its own closed polyline; project onto tangent plane. Choose south normal by opposite-side probes 50 km away using the original boundary for the real line. Transport the orientation to each shifted line.
shift_rule: Move each original station along its original south normal; recompute tangents/normals on the shifted line. Keep original station correspondence and original arc weights. Shifted lines may fold; record geometry defects rather than assuming a valid null.
boundary_classification: Curve2Mask at 0.25 degree nodes, nearest node; exclude real pairs unless north endpoint is north and south endpoint is south. Both endpoints and center of a shifted control must lie south of the true boundary.
geology: Direct point classification in authorized USGS SIM 3292 polygons; ambiguous/unassigned points excluded; no nearest-atlas age interpolation
noachian_rule: Single-period N codes only; exclude mixed HN/AN etc. Both Noachian does not imply equal epoch. Same rank is a stricter sensitivity, with undivided N and mN sharing rank 2.
control_center_rule: Require shifted center itself to be pure Noachian, in addition to its pair endpoints.

blocks.closure: Choose round(total_length/1000) equal arc bins to tile the closed curve without a short leftover block
blocks.statistic: Arc-weighted within-block mean, then equal-block-weighted mean; also report total retained arc-weighted mean descriptively

common_rule: For each distance and age selection, use the intersection valid on all three lines for both negative-control comparisons. Do not compare means on different support as a specificity test.

sign_flips.meaning: Conditional reference under joint invariance to whole-block sign reversal, not guaranteed by a 1000 km bin label

synthetic_null.field: Stationary zero-mean Gaussian log-field on 3-D spherical coordinates, approximated by 512 random Fourier features; evaluated on the actual selected stations and same block operators
synthetic_null.scope: Calibrate primary 150 km-equivalent geometry, d=200 km, both-Noachian, zero block offset: real line and two common-support differences. Same synthetic log-field definition for each geometry; no magnetic outcomes used.
synthetic_null.gate: Fewer than eight retained blocks or any tested null exceeding 7.5% false positives prevents a calibrated observed significance claim. Passing these nulls is conditional evidence, not proof of real-data exchangeability.

interpretation: Neither a positive step nor a small specificity difference selects an archive or field mechanism uniquely. No equivalence claim from a non-significant test. Broad Noachian matching does not control lithology, depth, reheating or spatial leakage.

regional_23.definitions: User-suggested geographic groups, fixed by coordinate boxes; labels are descriptive, not independently mapped geological provinces
regional_23.summaries: Area-weighted arithmetic mean |B|, back-transformed mean log(1+|B|) matching the original Test 1 statistic, and contribution to the total weighted log signal
regional_23.strong_anomaly_distance: Nearest southern atlas cell center with model |B| >= 100 nT at 150 km; declared descriptive threshold, 2 degree grid, not source localization or proof of contamination
